% Layout fixture: limits of sums as pdfTeX sets them. Five displays, each a shape that a real
% paper showed while the limits rule of pipeline 0.5.20 was built: a short sum whose line has
% three subscripted letters side by side, a sum behind a bracket that grows with it, a fraction
% with a sum in its numerator and one in its denominator, a sum behind a tall bracket under the
% line it continues, and a root under a fraction bar.
% Used by tests/test_layout_latex.py. Written for ReadableSTEM's tests; no third-party text.
%
% Built with pdfTeX, not with Tectonic as the fixtures one folder up are (make_pdfs.py does not
% look in this folder): Tectonic's glyph box of a sum sign reaches 4.6 pt further down than
% pdfTeX's at 10 pt, so none of the five shapes shows on a Tectonic page, and the papers that
% showed them are pdfTeX files. Rebuild, with the same bytes each time (pdfTeX 1.40.28, TeX
% Live 2025), from this folder:
%
%   SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791331200 FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1 \
%       pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error sum_limits_pdftex.tex
%
% and commit the PDF only after `uv run pytest tests/test_layout_latex.py` passes on it.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[OT1]{fontenc}
\renewcommand{\rmdefault}{cmr}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage[margin=0.8in]{geometry}
\pagestyle{empty}
\newcommand{\filler}{The value is counted once for each pair of rows and then added to the
total of the table, which is kept for the next step of the count and for the check at the end
of the run. }

\begin{document}

\filler
% A short sum: the line has three subscripted letters side by side and counts as a line of
% script size, and the limit under the sum was then too far from it.
\[ d_{ij} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{ik} b_{kl} c_{lj} \]
\filler
% A sum behind a bracket that grows with it, after a fraction and a word: the bracket and the
% sign are one row with no limit in it.
\begin{equation}
h_{\beta}^{\mathrm{LSE}}(v) := \frac{1}{\beta} \ln \left( \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A}} \exp(v(a) \beta) \right) ,
\end{equation}
\filler
% A fraction with a sum in the numerator and a sum in the denominator.
\[ \hat{\rho}_{l_n}^{\hat{Z}}(h) = \frac{\sum_{j=n-l_n+1}^{n-h} \hat{Z}_j \hat{Z}_{j+h}}{\sum_{j=n-l_n+1}^{n} \hat{Z}_j^2} . \]
\filler
% A sum behind a tall bracket, under the line it continues: the limit under the sum of the
% second line is no upper limit of the sum on the third.
\begin{align*}
& \mathbb{E}( \bar{W}_{n,A}(\theta) | \mathcal{F}_k )^2 \\
&= \left( \sum_{|u|=k} e^{\theta V(u) - k \kappa(\theta)} 1_{\{u \in E_1(k,A) \cap E_2(k,A)\}} H_{n,k,A}(V(u)) \right)^2 \\
&= \sum_{|u|=|v|=k, u \neq v} e^{\theta V(u) + \theta V(v) - 2k \kappa(\theta)} 1_{\{u,v \in E_1(k,A)\}} H_{n,k,A}(V(u)) \\
& \quad + \sum_{|u|=k} e^{2 \theta V(u) - 2k \kappa(\theta)} 1_{\{u \in E_1(k,A)\}} H_{n,k,A}(V(u))^2 .
\end{align*}
\filler
% A root under a fraction bar, the numerator of two terms: a root sign takes no limits.
\[ Z_n = \Bigl( \frac{V_1(u) - \kappa'_1(\theta) t_n}{\sqrt{t_n}} \Bigr) \]
\filler

\end{document}
